workstream_count.description: Must equal the number of workstreams in the state file.

project.description: Display name used in the HTML title and header. Defaults to the state's project.heading before the first ' · '.

slug.description: File stem: <slug>-project-state.json and <slug>-project-mindmap.{html,svg,png}. Defaults to the state filename's stem.

ref_label.description: Words before the evidence ref in the snapshot caption, e.g. 'kioskit main'. Defaults to 'main'.

issues_label.description: Display name of the third stage, e.g. 'Issues', 'Approval', 'Review', 'Planning'. The state key stays 'issues'. Defaults to 'Issues'.

issues_note.description: The legend sentence explaining the third stage. Defaults to '<issues_label> ✓ means linked, not closed.'
